$comment: Demonic Pacts League echo orbs, applied by plugins/modes/league/EchoOrbs.LeagueMode.js. Rates and the guarantee are from the Wiki (Demonic_Pacts_League/Echo_bosses_and_echo_equipment and Echo_orb, read 2026-11-13): each regional boss drops its region's orb at `rate` (1 in N; 1 is the Wiki's 'Guaranteed') and guarantees it once the kills since the last orb reach N. `npcs` are the NPC names whose kills roll it (NpcDrops' npc-drops:add, once per kill), `npcIds` NpcIdentifiers names where a name is shared (the quests' Hespori and Amoxliatl are not the regular bosses), `sources` the `source` other rollers pass on npc-drops:roll (the Gauntlet's reward chest). `title` is the Yes/No menu the boss's entrance opens while the orb is carried; `titleOurs` marks a title no capture shows. `leagues` are the league types (6 Demonic Pacts) whose characters get any of this.
